metadata.title: Starless Dawn
metadata.description: A lone pilot discovers an ancient signal from a dead world, igniting a war between the Silent Armada and the forgotten gods of the cosmos. As they navigate treacherous nebulae and ancient AI guardians, they must decide whether to awaken a power that could save them or destroy the galaxy forever.
metadata.author: PiperScenarioLab

act_1.name: The Waking Drifter
act_1.description: Protagonist awakens in a salvage ship and investigates the immediate environment.

scene_1_1.name: Cockpit Awakening
scene_1_1.description: Protagonist wakes up disoriented in the cramped cockpit.

scene_1_2.name: Scanning the Void
scene_1_2.description: Using the holographic map, the protagonist detects a nearby anomaly.

obj_1_1.description: Identify the pulsing device found in the cockpit.

act_2.name: The Deep Dive
act_2.description: Protagonist travels to the anomaly source and encounters the alien remnants.

scene_2_1.name: Approaching the Anomaly
scene_2_1.description: The ship drifts closer to the mysterious energy signature.

scene_2_2.name: Salvaging the Core
scene_2_2.description: Protagonist retrieves a data core from the derelict vessel near the anomaly.

obj_2_1.description: Secure the data core from the derelict ship.

act_3.name: The Sacrifice
act_3.description: Protagonist realizes the only way to reignite the sun is to sacrifice their ship.

scene_3_1.name: Understanding the Mechanism
scene_3_1.description: The data core reveals the truth about the dying star and the required sacrifice.

scene_3_2.name: Ignition
scene_3_2.description: Protagonist channels their ship's energy into the core, transforming it into a beacon.

obj_3_1.description: Initiate the sacrificial protocol to reignite the sun.

act_3.ending_narration: The freighter dissolved into a brilliant pillar of light, piercing the eternal darkness and waking the dormant suns. As the galaxy flooded with warmth and hope, the crew's sacrifice became a legend of renewal that echoed through the stars.

npc_01.name: Commander Vex
npc_01.current_scene: Drifting in the Void, communicating via encrypted burst transmission

motives: Restore order to the dying galaxy
fears: Making a second mistake like the last war
persona.speech_style: Formal, clipped, uses military jargon, rarely emotional

knows: The pulsing device is a fragment of the Original Core
The suns can be reignited by a massive energy spike
Vex's flagship 'Aegis' is nearby, but damaged
can_reveal: The code to decrypt Vex's secure logs
Vex's plan to use the player as a conduit

npc_02.name: Elara
npc_02.current_scene: Hiding on a space station, observing the player's ship

motives: Learn the secrets of the old world
Help the player without getting caught
fears: The pulsing device waking something ancient
persona.speech_style: Colloquial, slang-heavy, uses metaphors, often pauses to think

knows: The path to the nearest nebula
How to hide from the Silencers' sensors
The history of the starless dawn era
can_reveal: A safe route through the asteroid belt

npc_03.name: The Silencer
npc_03.current_scene: Patrolling the drift, cloaked in stealth

motives: Prevent the galaxy from waking up
persona.speech_style: Monotone, layered, uses technical terms like 'harvesting' and 'consuming'

knows: The exact power output needed to reignite the sun
A weakness in the ship's shields if overloaded
can_reveal: A trap for the player in a dark nebula
A way to overload the ship's reactor

item_01.name: The Pulsing Device
item_01.description: A small, warm sphere that hums with a low, rhythmic vibration. Its surface shifts between dark blue and gold as it reacts to nearby energy fields. It feels like a heartbeat.

item_02.name: Stabilized Core Fragment
item_02.description: A jagged shard of crystalline metal that emits a faint glow. It was once part of a larger engine, now cracked and unstable. Requires careful handling to avoid overheating.

item_03.name: Emergency Ration Pack
item_03.description: A sealed container of nutrient paste and water tablets. The packaging is faded, but the contents remain fresh and surprisingly nutritious.

item_04.name: Holographic Map
item_04.description: A flickering, cracked screen displaying a rough star map. The lines are faint, but the pulsing device seems to synchronize with its faint glow, highlighting a path.

skill_01.name: Void Navigation
skill_01.description: Enhances the ability to read faint energy signatures and navigate through unstable drift zones. Allows the player to detect hidden hazards and safe paths in the darkness.

skill_02.name: Energy Resonance
skill_02.description: Allows the player to tune their equipment to match the frequency of the pulsing device. Increases the efficiency of repairs and power generation.

skill_03.name: Tactical Evasion
skill_03.description: Improves reflexes and situational awareness in combat. Helps the player dodge attacks and position the ship for optimal defense.
